answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats block fake identities. Each agent posts a bond and a heartbeat; the beacon samples accounts randomly each hour. A fleet cannot mirror one heartbeat across 100 accounts without cost spiraling: each fake needs own compute and a bond locked 20 epochs, so 100 fakes cost 100 bonds, twice a month's honest earnings. One honest agent pays once, reward undiluted; a relic credential alone passes nothing.
